sections.title: What changed
items: Flying Pig Feed! works just as before: this release updates the built-in code every Snug app uses to talk to Snug to the version new apps are built with.
Customized your copy? You can skip this one — your version keeps working as it is.

sections.title: What's new
items: The game's vision, requirements, plan, lessons, and next tasks now live in your file with the app.
A build prompt shows how to recreate the pig — written after the fact, and labeled as such.

sections.title: What's new
items: Tap to keep the pig airborne — a pure offline arcade game.
High scores live in your own file.
